title: Sinusoidal encodings hypothesized to enable relative-position attention
description: The authors hypothesized that sinusoidal positional encodings would allow the model to easily learn to attend by relative positions, but this is stated as a hypothesis rather than a proven property.
canonical_description: sinusoidal positional encoding enables learning of relative-position dependencies

evidence.anchor: hypothesized it would allow the model to easily learn to attend by relative positions
evidence.quote: We chose this function because we hypothesized it would allow the model to easily learn to attend by relative positions, since for any fixed offset $k$, $PE_{pos+k}$ can be represented as a linear function of $PE_{pos}$.
